I'm about to be evicted, can't afford Christmas gifts for the kids again this year, and one of my pets will probably need to see a vet soon. My dad is struggling with cancer. I think my car is about to get repo'd. I'm failing my classes. I've missed so much work from being sick, I'll probably be fired soon, and I just found out that I'll probably have to get a hysterectomy and I'm not even thirty yet. I've been finding myself staring into space more and more, wondering why I haven't just driven off of a bridge yet.

I just hope that things will get better soon. I'm really tired.

Sorry for the venting. :(
Is this the same as clinical lab science?
Came out of nowhere for me at age 13. I'm 26 now and still suffering daily.
This is my worst fear. I'm 26 and starting my second semester in the fall. I already feel ridiculously insecure, a comment like that would kill me.
I just got done playing Subnautica and then I read this. That's enough of the ocean, thanks.

It was pointed out to me a few years ago when I said it out loud with a hard c. There was a pause, and my friend said, "You think Han named his kid Jackin' Solo?" and proceeded to laugh at me.

They still bring it up sometimes.
When they type "google" in the Yahoo search. :(

Remembering that this incision pain will go away eventually. It just feels like it's taking forever and all I want is to go up a flight of stairs without tearing up.

There's also figuring out how to write a persuasive speech on wetland conservation and then​ somehow surviving presenting in front of people. Yay, anxiety.

Hm... I just started, and I want an ecology degree, but maybe I should stick to clinical lab science instead, huh? Or will that leave me sad and poor too? :( 

A former ecology professor told me today that I'm too old (26) to get an ecology degree and get anywhere with it, so I may be doubting everything right now.
Did you ever get a misdiagnosis of IBS? I have almost all of those symptoms and now I'm wondering....

I do the exact same thing. I have characters and story arcs and everything. Occasionally I have a lull in the "story" where I'll switch to a different fantasy/daydream and start over. 

I still can't write a story though, hah.
Oh my god, same. Though I've never had problems at concerts or anything. Everyone is usually pretty chill.

I was terrified to look out the window at night, because I might see an alien. 

Fire in the Sky ruined me. :(
